banner.title: The Artificer devices round - Ward's Magic and Science: Are They Compatible in D&D? (folios 8, 10)
banner.provenance: Pinned from The Dragon Vol. 1 No. 1 (June 1976): folios 8 and 10, James M. Ward's Magic and Science article (the chain runs 8 -> 10 past Gold's Languages on 9) - the Artificer pistol and its six color-coded spheres, the three blue-sphere rank badges with their two beams and ray suites, and the anologic computer with its heat core and its logic weakness. The Parked box was un-parked at Curtiss's call: the items sweep.
banner.sentinel: The variant-layer doctrine holds: Dragon ink is never core 1e canon. These are science-magic devices presented against too-powerful players, pinned as scanned; the sphere effect codes are CONVERTED integers - 1 melting heat, 2 disintegration, 3 nullification, 4 the illusion maze, 5 the death circle, 6 the crystal wall - the legend pinned beside the grid, the conversion noted, never silent. The silver wall and the smallest sphere's healing-void carry scanned zeros, noted in the column comments. OD&D-era ink converted per the walk doctrine: the pin IS the conversion, noted, never silent.

audit_comment: THE ARTIFICER DEVICES ROUND - the un-parked items sweep of issue 1's Parked list (Curtiss's call, 2026-10-29). Ward's magic-and-science devices pinned as variant-layer items: the pistol frame (two-inch sphere, fifty yards, six color-coded types), the six-sphere grid with the CONVERTED effect codes and the save gates (only black disintegration and purple death carry the save - red, clear, brown expressly do not), the silver crystal wall (60 x 120 x 10, fills any passage, diamond resistance), the blue-sphere badge grid (three sizes, two beams each, the ray suites inverted to size, the smallest most powerful), the chassis doctrines (25 hit points, the anti-magic kill, the displacer provenance), and the computer (heat core, 100 spells analyzed, the double heat ray off enemy hit points, the logic weakness). The chain runs folio 8 -> 10 past Gold's Languages; the effect-code conversion and the scanned zeros are noted, never silent.
